items.headline:
China’s demand for gold remains robust:

China officially bought 1 tonne of gold in February, marking the 16th consecutive monthly purchase.

Over this period, China has acquired 50 tonnes of gold. 

By comparison, in 2022-2024, the buying streak lasted for 18 straight months.

items.headline:
Wall Street is selling gold and silver to retail investors:

Since Q2 2025, retail investors have bought +$70 billion in gold ETFs.

These purchases have more than TRIPLED over the last 6 months.

Over the same period, institutional investors have sold -$1 billion with outflows

The rise in U.S. diesel prices is now record-setting, according to GasBuddy:
• Largest 2-week increase EVER (+$1.22/gal)
• Largest 3-week increase EVER (+$1.33/gal)
• Largest 4-week increase EVER (+$1.44/gal)
Prices aren’t at record highs- but the speed of this surge is.
